# shadcn-egui-icons-lucide

The Lucide icon set for [shadcn-egui](https://crates.io/crates/shadcn-egui),
the shadcn/ui design system for egui.

You do not depend on this crate directly. `shadcn-egui` always includes it:
Lucide is the default icon set.
